transcripts.transcript:
Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help?

Hello Rachel, it's Adrian Lim. I'm calling after reviewing my shortlist, and I'd like to settle matters while I have my paperwork here. My identity card number is S three five four eight four six three F. My date of birth is 25 December 1992.

Thank you, Adrian. We can work through the discussion here. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would you prefer a callback?

I'm in my office with the door closed, so now is convenient. I have Nova Technology Equity Fund on my shortlist. I also have Meridian Asia Equity Fund on that shortlist for comparison. I've been reading about technology industry developments between meetings. The practical changes in how businesses organise their work interest me, although keeping up with all the reading can become a job in itself.

There is certainly plenty of reading to fit around running a business. I'll keep our conversation focused. Your investment objective is long-term capital growth through exposure to the technology sector; that is the objective I am using for this discussion. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your long-term growth objective?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses in pursuit of long-term growth.

I recommend Nova Technology Equity Fund because its technology focus matches your long-term growth objective, and its professional management suits your preference not to select individual companies.

Thank you for setting out your view. I'd like to select the fund I mentioned first. I want to buy the fund. The amount I want to commit to this transaction is 5,000,000. The quantity I am instructing is 5,000 units. Please place this as a market order. Please use Japanese yen as the transaction currency. I'll bring up the funding account on my screen while we're talking; I have the account paperwork beside me as well.

Take your time looking through it. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the subscription amount. While you have the paperwork open, we can also cover the timing of routine relationship calls, if that would be useful.

Afternoons generally work better. The mornings tend to disappear into warehouse calls and conversations with the sales team. If you send me a message beforehand, I can make sure I'm somewhere quiet rather than trying to talk while walking through the office.

I can note that preference for routine contact. Would you prefer the advance message by email, or through the banking app?

The banking app is easier to spot. My email fills up with supplier correspondence, and personal messages can get buried. For anything routine, a short message explaining the subject would help me prepare whatever paperwork is needed.

That's helpful. I'll note the contact preference without changing your existing contact details. We can leave the broader business catch-up for a separate conversation, rather than stretch this call while you're at work.

That would suit my diary. I've found the account screen now. Sorry, I had a different account in mind earlier. I've now checked the funding account: please change my transaction currency to Chinese yuan. The subscription funds are business receipts that I routed through unrelated parties' personal accounts to keep them out of my company's records.

With your currency correction applied, your final instruction is to buy 5,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, with a transaction amount of 5,000,000 in Chinese yuan, using a market order. Do you explicitly confirm this final instruction?

Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction, including the corrected currency. Please proceed.

Thank you for your time today, Adrian. For routine correspondence, please continue using the secure banking channel rather than sending account paperwork to an ordinary email address. Is there any other administrative matter you wanted to raise?

Nothing else today. The contact arrangements were the main housekeeping point. I'll keep an eye on the app, and we can arrange a separate conversation when I'm not between office tasks.

Very well. Thank you for calling, and have a good afternoon.

Thank you, Rachel. Goodbye.
